select tr.id, tr.name, tm.id as membersId, tm.member_name, tr.create_user_id, tr.create_user_name, tr.create_time, tr.template_id, trrm.id as roleRefMembersId from template_role tr inner join template_role_ref_members trrm on tr.id = trrm.role_id and tr.template_id = trrm.template_id inner join template_members tm on trrm.members_id = tm.id and tm.template_id = trrm.template_id
AND tr.is_deleted = FALSE
and tr.name like concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword} ,'%')
and tr.template_id = #{params.templateId}
ORDER BY tr.create_time DESC
